definitions.duration: Containment calendar date minus discovery calendar date, consistently normalized to midnight; containment differs from fire-out.
definitions.same_calendar_day: Calendar duration equals zero: containment occurred on the discovery calendar date. This does not mean zero elapsed time.
definitions.over_3_days: Containment calendar date is more than three days after discovery calendar date. This is not verified initial-attack failure.
definitions.quantiles: Unweighted empirical calendar-duration quantiles using linear interpolation; aggregated quantiles may be fractional despite integral record-level durations.
definitions.five_year_eras: Five-year intervals aligned to multiples of five. The 1990–1994 era contains only observed 1992–1994 records; observed_year_min/max identify available years.
definitions.cause: Source NWCG ignition-cause classification; missing or blank classifications are Unknown. Ignition cause does not establish suppression policy.

caveats: All values in this summary are observed, unadjusted descriptions of the usable containment cohort, not model estimates or causal effects.
Containment-date availability and reporting-agency composition change by year; observed trends can reflect changing reporting and selection.
Only continental-U.S. records with positive final acreage and valid 0–365-day containment intervals enter this cohort; it is not all U.S. wildfire records.
Final acreage is an eventual fire outcome. Comparing size bins describes similarly sized completed fires but does not isolate suppression capability.
The first five-year era has three observed years. Counts across eras should not be compared as annual incidence without accounting for exposure years.
Overall quantiles combine very different fire sizes, causes, locations, weather, and agencies; apparent changes can result from changing composition.
Calendar-day summaries intentionally avoid mixing records with and without reported clock times; they cannot resolve changes within the same day.

checked: all grouping counts partition the cohort
same-day and >3-day counts match across groupings
